bell.name: The Silent Bell
bell.text: Speak to Ilya. Defeat the forest sentinel for the sigil, enter the crypt, silence the Bellkeeper, then visit the shrine.

herbs.name: A Gentle Mercy
herbs.text: Bring three Weeping Herbs to Sister Elowen.

charm.name: A Brother’s Shadow
charm.text: Recover the Silver Charm from a forest chest. Return it or keep it.

iron.name: Iron Remembers
iron.text: Bring three Grave Iron to Brann.

elites.name: Three Unquiet Souls
elites.text: Defeat the forest sentinel, the lost hound and the crypt knight.
